en:
Step into the exhilarating mayhem of Felforged Mode. In this rogue-like spin-off, you trade your soul to the Legion for unprecedented power. With a fast-paced progression system, you earn 500% increased experience rates and have a significantly increased chance to find loot in the open world. However, the real thrill comes from the game's high-stakes mechanic: if you die, you reset back to level 20, making each play session a unique and adrenaline-filled endeavor.

Felforged Mode is a free-for-all PvP experience with the pulse-pounding excitement of a session-based PvP game. Your journey begins at the Legion's stronghold, Demon's Tears, in the Twisting Nether. From there, you will drop into Azeroth as a Legion Meteor, leaving a trail of destruction in your wake. Kill, Loot, Die, Repeat, and become stronger as you reap souls from the players you vanquish. With entirely random abilities every time you level, no two play sessions will be the same.

Take on Felforged Challenges for an extra test of your skill and courage. Completing these trials rewards you with Legion Crests, which can be used to obtain unique rewards. You can also group with other Felforged players to conquer these challenges, adding another layer of strategy to this high-risk, high-reward game mode.

Will you risk it all in the pursuit of power? Enter the Felforged Mode, embrace the chaos, and carve your path to infamy.
